title: Parity checker for localised .resx files
goal: Write a repeatable checker in Python that compares every language variant of a set of .resx files with its neutral file and writes a report. The attached files are samples of the format (40 entries each); the real set has 63 files. Deliver the checker and its tests in one Markdown document. Never change a .resx file: the texts are regulated product content.
acceptance: The checker reports missing keys, extra keys, empty values, mismatched placeholders such as {0}, invalid XML and leftover markup or source-language text, in JSON and in Markdown.
The checker exits with a non-zero code when any key is missing.
The document contains pytest tests on synthetic .resx files written by the tests themselves.
The checker only reads .resx files and never writes to them.
The document proposes no translations and no wording for product claims.
key: Run on the full set, the report lists one key missing in five Nordic locale files (725 against 726 keys).
